verdict.rationale: Grafana has substantial programmatic surface area. A probe found an OpenAPI spec at grafana.com/api/openapi.json, and the as-code docs say dashboards, data sources and other configurations can be defined in code and deployed through CI/CD. The docs also describe terminal tooling for authentication and administrative tasks, file-based provisioning, and an official MCP server for agents. However, nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API covers everything the UI can do, and features like alerting, SLOs and incident response are described only in UI terms. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or demonstration of API/UI feature parity, API coverage evidence for alerting, SLO, on-call and incident features, and independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.
